description: This file declares classes related to blocking closures used in inter-process communication (IPC) within the Rialto project. It includes factory class for creating blocking closure instances, and concrete classes implementing blocking behavior via polling and semaphores.

classes.name: BlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating blocking closure instances, either poll-based or semaphore-based.

classes.name: BlockingClosurePoll
classes.description: Implementation of IBlockingClosure that uses polling on an IPC channel.

classes.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore
classes.description: Implementation of IBlockingClosure that uses a semaphore for synchronization.

methods.name: createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a BlockingClosurePoll instance associated with a given IPC channel.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the blocking closure's main operation.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the closure's operation is complete.
